info.title: Craftboxx Universal API
info.description: Craftboxx is field service and job-planning software for trades businesses, covering projects, assignments, customers, staff, time tracking, materials, tools, vehicles, and site documentation.

get.description: Returns unavailable assignment master data for a date range from Craftboxx.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The interval end timestamp.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Optional assignment ID to exclude from the availability check.

schema.description: Optional assignment ID to exclude from the availability check.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The interval start timestamp.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

employees.description: Unavailable employees in the requested interval.

tools.description: Unavailable tools in the requested interval.

vehicles.description: Unavailable vehicles in the requested interval.
